capabilities: Replace empty tabs with a start page
Search vault filenames and aliases with fuzzy matching
List bookmarks, recent files and templates in sections
Create notes from markdown templates with date and time variables
Capture search input as a bullet in today's daily note
extras: Fork of Home tab kept under the MIT License with the original copyright; interface and tips available in English and Korean; no telemetry or remote search service; requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or later, and testing on physical mobile devices and the minimum supported version is still pending.
intentEvidence: This project was created by forking olrenso/obsidian-home-tab.
motivation: The author wanted to help Obsidian beginners use the app with ease by bringing common actions together and introducing basic features and core plugins through short hints and tips.
problem: Empty new tabs give no starting point, and beginners must hunt through commands and core plugins to reach common actions.

relations.evidence: This project was created by forking olrenso/obsidian-home-tab.

summary: Start page that replaces empty Obsidian tabs with fuzzy file search, bookmarks, recent files, template-based note creation and beginner tips.
